{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Nations that support terrorism are just as dangerous as the perpetrators of terrorism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nations that support terrorism are just as guilty as the perpetrators of terrorism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Every nation must choose to support terror or to support America and its coalition to defeat terror.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America is preserving the peace by working with more than 80 allied nations and international institutions to isolate and confront terrorists and outlaw regimes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America is leading a broad coalition of nations to disrupt proliferation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America is working with the United Nations, the International Atomic Energy Agency, and other international organizations to take action in common security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The global threat of terrorism requires a global response.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To be effective, a global response to terrorism requires leadership, and America is providing that leadership.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is no negotiation with terrorists.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No form of therapy or coercion will turn terrorists from their murderous ways.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Only total and complete destruction of terrorism will allow freedom to flourish.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America will support the rise of democracy as an alternative to hatred and terror in the broader Middle East.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In democratic societies, people do not swear allegiance to malcontents and murderers, but focus on building better lives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democratic governments do not shelter terrorist camps or attack their neighbors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"When justice and democracy advance, the hope of lasting peace increases.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
